articles.title: COSO Principle 1 — Commitment to integrity and ethical values
articles.requirement: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values through its code of conduct, tone at the top, and established expectations of behaviour.

articles.title: COSO Principle 2 — Board exercises oversight responsibility
articles.requirement: The board of directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight of the development and performance of internal control.

articles.title: COSO Principle 3 — Management establishes structure and authority
articles.requirement: Management establishes, with board oversight, structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities and responsibilities in the pursuit of objectives.

articles.title: COSO Principle 4 — Commitment to competence
articles.requirement: The entity demonstrates a commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals in alignment with objectives.

articles.title: COSO Principle 5 — Accountability for internal control
articles.requirement: The entity holds individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities in the pursuit of objectives.

articles.title: COSO Principle 13 — Quality information
articles.requirement: The entity obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control.

articles.title: COSO Principle 14 — Internal communication
articles.requirement: The entity internally communicates information, including objectives and responsibilities for internal control, necessary to support the functioning of internal control.

articles.title: COSO Principle 15 — External communication
articles.requirement: The entity communicates with external parties regarding matters affecting the functioning of internal control.

articles.title: COSO Principle 6 — Risk assessment objectives
articles.requirement: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable the identification and assessment of risks relating to objectives.

articles.title: COSO Principle 7 — Risk identification and analysis
articles.requirement: The entity identifies risks to the achievement of its objectives across the entity and analyses risks as a basis for determining how the risks should be managed.

articles.title: COSO Principle 8 — Fraud risk assessment
articles.requirement: The entity considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks to the achievement of objectives.

articles.title: COSO Principle 9 — Significant change identification
articles.requirement: The entity identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact the system of internal control.

articles.title: COSO Principle 16 — Monitoring activities
articles.requirement: The entity selects, develops, and performs ongoing and/or separate evaluations to ascertain whether the components of internal control are present and functioning.

articles.title: COSO Principle 17 — Communication of deficiencies
articles.requirement: The entity evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies in a timely manner to those parties responsible for taking corrective action.

articles.title: COSO Principle 10 — Selection of control activities
articles.requirement: The entity selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of objectives to acceptable levels.

articles.title: COSO Principle 11 — Technology general controls
articles.requirement: The entity selects and develops general control activities over technology to support the achievement of objectives.

articles.title: COSO Principle 12 — Policies and procedures deployment
articles.requirement: The entity deploys control activities through policies that establish what is expected and procedures that put policies into action.

articles.title: Logical and physical access security
articles.requirement: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets to protect them from security events.

articles.title: User registration and authorisation
articles.requirement: Prior to issuing system credentials and granting system access, the entity registers and authorises new internal and external users based on an authorisation process.

articles.title: Role-based access and least privilege
articles.requirement: The entity authorises, modifies, or removes access to data, software, functions, and other protected assets based on roles, responsibilities, or the system design and its vulnerabilities.

articles.title: Restriction and review of physical access
articles.requirement: The entity restricts physical access to facilities and protected information assets to authorised personnel and reviews access periodically.

articles.title: Discontinuation of logical and physical protections over assets
articles.requirement: The entity discontinues logical and physical protections over physical assets only after the ability to read or recover data has been diminished to an acceptable level.

articles.title: Security controls outside system boundaries
articles.requirement: The entity implements controls to restrict access to data and systems located outside the defined system boundaries, including data transmitted to third parties.

articles.title: Restriction and management of data transmission
articles.requirement: The entity restricts the transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorised internal and external users and processes.

articles.title: Prevention and detection of unauthorised software
articles.requirement: The entity implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorised or malicious software.

articles.title: Detection of security events
articles.requirement: The entity uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify anomalies and security events including identification of vulnerabilities and changes to configurations.

articles.title: Monitoring of system components for anomalies
articles.requirement: The entity monitors system components and the operation of those components for anomalies that are indicative of malicious acts, natural disasters, and errors.

articles.title: Evaluation of security events
articles.requirement: The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they could or have resulted in a failure of the entity to meet its objectives (security incidents).

articles.title: Incident response
articles.requirement: The entity responds to identified security incidents by executing a defined incident response programme to understand, contain, remediate, and communicate security incidents.

articles.title: Incident recovery
articles.requirement: The entity identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover from identified security incidents.

articles.title: Change management
articles.requirement: The entity authorises, designs, develops, configures, documents, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures to meet its objectives.

articles.title: Risk mitigation
articles.requirement: The entity identifies, selects, and develops risk mitigation activities for risks arising from potential business disruptions.

articles.title: Vendor and business partner risk management
articles.requirement: The entity assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners.

articles.title: Capacity management
articles.requirement: The entity maintains, monitors, and evaluates current processing capacity and use of system components to manage capacity demand and enable implementation of additional capacity.

articles.title: Recovery of infrastructure and software
articles.requirement: The entity authorises, designs, develops, implements, operates, approves, maintains, and monitors environmental protections, software, data back-up, and recovery to meet its objectives.

articles.title: Testing of recovery plans
articles.requirement: The entity tests recovery plan procedures supporting system recovery to meet its objectives.

articles.title: Processing completeness, accuracy, and timeliness
articles.requirement: The entity obtains or generates, uses, and communicates relevant, quality information regarding processing objectives to support the use of products and services.

articles.title: System inputs are complete, accurate, and valid
articles.requirement: The entity implements policies and procedures over system inputs to result in products, services, and reporting that are complete, accurate, and valid.

articles.title: System processing is complete, accurate, timely, and authorised
articles.requirement: The entity implements policies and procedures over system processing to result in products, services, and reporting that are complete, accurate, timely, and authorised.

articles.title: System output is complete, accurate, and distributed as intended
articles.requirement: The entity implements policies and procedures to make available or deliver output completely, accurately, and timely in accordance with specifications.

articles.title: Inputs and outputs are stored completely and accurately
articles.requirement: The entity implements policies and procedures to store inputs, items in processing, and outputs completely, accurately, and timely in accordance with system specifications.

articles.title: Identification of confidential information
articles.requirement: The entity identifies and maintains confidential information to meet the entity's objectives related to confidentiality.

articles.title: Disposal of confidential information
articles.requirement: The entity disposes of confidential information to meet the entity's objectives related to confidentiality.

articles.title: Privacy notice
articles.requirement: The entity provides notice to data subjects about its privacy practices to meet its objectives related to privacy, including purpose, types of data, retention, and rights.

articles.title: Choice and consent
articles.requirement: The entity communicates choices available regarding collection, use, retention, disclosure, and disposal of personal information and obtains implicit or explicit consent.

articles.title: Collection of personal information
articles.requirement: Personal information is collected consistent with the entity's objectives related to privacy, limited to that necessary for the purposes identified in the privacy notice.

articles.title: Use, retention, and disposal
articles.requirement: The entity limits the use of personal information to the purposes identified in the privacy notice and retains it only for as long as needed, with secure disposal thereafter.

articles.title: Access to personal information
articles.requirement: The entity grants identified and authenticated data subjects the ability to access their stored personal information for review and to request updates or corrections.

articles.title: Disclosure and notification of personal information
articles.requirement: The entity discloses personal information to third parties with consent and notifies data subjects of such disclosures or privacy incidents as required.

articles.title: Quality of personal information
articles.requirement: The entity collects and maintains accurate, up-to-date, complete, and relevant personal information for the purposes identified in the privacy notice.

articles.title: Dispute resolution and complaint management
articles.requirement: The entity has a process for data subjects to inquire, complain, and resolve disputes about the entity's privacy and compliance practices.
